 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Dr. Anshuman
 Oral Order
2 19-06-2023

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the N.T.P.C. and learned counsel for the State.
2.

The present writ petition has been filed for the following relief(s):
(i) For enhancement of the Awards amount of 100% according to new Scheme/ Policy of 2007, L.A. Act, 1894 and New L.A. Act, 2014.
(a) For regarding enhancement of 100% compensation of Award amount of acquired land of Mr. Senapati Mahto S/o Late Patna High Court CWJC No.9682 of 2014(2)
dt.19-06-2023 Ramswaroop Mahot in L.A. Case No. 9 of 2006-07 in respect of alleged acquired land having an area 3.43 Acre these acquired plot of land situated at Senapati Mahto vs The State Of Bihar And Ors on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150036259/

1 Shekhpura Part-2 in Thana No.-12, Village- Shekhpura, Post- Gowasha Shekhpura P.S. Pandarak, Barh, District- Patna is bearing:-
Award No. Khata No. Kheshra No. Area 05 118 1728 0.71 Acre 05 118 1732 0.68 Acre 05 118 1743 0.51 Acre 05 118 1769 1.26 Acre 05 118 1775 0.27 Acre Total 3.43 Acre (b) The petitioner had already received the 100% Award amount Rs.12,31,894.24 received much earlier of acquired land from N.T.P.C. of Mauza-Shekhpura Part-II, at the rate of Rs.3,59,152.84 per Acre only but according to provision 1, 1.1-(I), (II) and 2(1.1)-Kha- (I), (II), (III) and (1.2)- II (Ka) and (Kha) of Gayapank- 15/D.L.A. Scheme (Re-habilitation) Patna High Court CWJC No.9682 of 2014(2) dt.19-06-2023 07/06- 747/Ra, dated 13.05.2008 of Bihar Land Acquisition Re-established and Re- habilitation Scheme-2007, the valuation must be fixed for all acquired land at different Mauza for same Project (N.T.P.C.) must be similar i.e. the highest value of any acquired land will be the value of all acquired land for the same project and hence, the petitioner is entitled for compensation amount of final Award with the same rate.

(ii) For a direction or directions to this respondents to treat this petitioner in Award No. 05 in L.A.
Case No. 9 of 2006-07 according to New Amended Policy, 2007 L.A. Act-1894 and New Act 2014,
the petitioner is entitled to get the payment of award amount of compensation at the rate and interest should be calculated at the rate of provided in the statue.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the land of the petitioner was acquired and award was prepared.
Counsel submits that petitioner has received payment vide Patna High Court CWJC No.9682 of 2014(2) dt.19-06-2023 Annexure- 4 of the writ petition.
He submits that his grievance is very limited that he is entitled for final award amount according to Bihar Land Acquisition Re-established and Re- habilitation Scheme-2007.

entities.text: Bihar Land Acquisition Re-established and Re- habilitation Scheme-2007.
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Counsel submits in this regard that he has filed his representation vide Annexure-11 dated 26.11.2013.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that even after his representation, no decision has been taken by the authority.
5. Learned counsel for the State seeks time to file the counter affidavit.
It is a case of 2014, even after lapse of about nine years, neither representation of the petitioner dated 26.11.2013, nor counter affidavit has been filed.
Waiting for counter affidavit shall further delay this matter.

6. In this view of the matter, this Court is directed the petitioner to file a fresh representation before the Collector, Patna District, Patna, who shall pass appropriate order on the representation of the petitioner and if, petitioner found entitled to be covered under Scheme of 2007 as he demanded in the writ petition, appropriate order shall be passed within four weeks thereafter and payment in this regard is directed to be made within eight weeks thereafter, if found entitled.
